name: Tall Box
description: A box that holds 18 marbles — double the normal load — while still taking up a single grid cell. It just stands twice as tall.
howToPlay: The purple Tall Box on the left is open from the start — tap it and watch 18 marbles pour out in one go. The sealed column in the middle can only be opened from the bottom: tap your way up it, and the green Tall Box in that stack shows how a tall box sits in one ordinary cell while overhanging the box above it.
